supplier_acceptance.application: Set n=d in {1,2,3}; x=2 pi y transports the probability measure to (2 pi)^(-d) dx and exp(2 pi i k dot y) to exp(i k dot x), so coefficients/norms agree exactly. For nonnegative Sobolev orders the weight is at least one, so the completion embeds in L2. No claim of an L2 representative for negative-order distributions is being accepted.
